xs.$description: Inline/badge icons: info dots, small counters.

sm.$description: Small UI icons: upload/download, list chevrons.

md.$description: Default icon size — nav bars, list rows, buttons.

lg.$description: Prominent icons: modal close buttons, statistics.

xl.$description: Hero icons: empty states, large play/heart buttons.

minTouchTarget.$description: Minimum touch target per Apple HIG (44pt) / Material (48dp) guidance.
